t: This building is Redholm, in Southwark. It was designed by John Belcher, an English architect who rose to become president of the Royal Institute of British Architects, the profession's leading body in Britain. There isn't much more on record about the house itself here, but Belcher's role is the reason it's worth a look. Take in the frontage and the details, and think of it as the work of someone his fellow architects chose to lead them.
